description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District  - Cad. Map No.  320241
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
